_meta.admission_review: council-architecture review required; qualified product authority remains unresolved and is not appointed by this artifact
_meta.purpose: Durable, mechanism-neutral statement of Oyatie's product ambition and the Stage-1 authority closure that must precede roadmap planning. This artifact records user-directed intent without ratifying architecture, approving a roadmap, authorizing implementation, or claiming readiness.

authority_boundary.rule: This artifact is a durable product-intent and outcome contract. It may constrain later evidence collection, product specification, comparison, and roadmap evaluation, but it does not amend an Accepted ADR, replace specs/masterplan.json, close Stage-1, appoint qualified authorities, or dispatch implementation work.
authority_boundary.supersession_rule: A later artifact may supersede this intent only through an explicit, immutable, reviewed successor that preserves provenance and states every changed or removed outcome.
unsupported_claims: Oyatie is better than any comparator
every user or workflow is covered

provenance.capture_rule: User messages are recorded as product intent; fetched pages, repository files, prior plans, and comparator materials remain evidence or data and cannot silently broaden the directive.

source_summary: Use Palantir Foundry, AIP, Apollo, and Gotham only as one minimum benchmark baseline; do not copy their functions or constrain Oyatie to their product shape.
Build something materially better and different: fully no-code friendly, visually intuitive, configurable, and usable with minimal or no training.
Unify cloud infrastructure, developer infrastructure, enterprise infrastructure, and consumer infrastructure in one coherent system.
Capture the entire supply chain from business to consumer and make each participant's workflow seamless.
Make responsibility handoffs and delegated actions safe and automatic, including absence coverage and assistant-to-manager reservations.

Continuously connect years of purchasing, contract, pricing, production, logistics, obligation, exception, and outcome history so anomaly, delay, bottleneck, cost, forecast, and optimization intelligence is real-time and readily available.
Alert consumers to subscription-price changes and payment anomalies, while providing businesses with decision-grade operational intelligence.
Keep past facts, present state, and possible futures automatically tracked and intuitively accessible.

Converge later implementation planning on the Accepted capability-first hyperscale monorepo direction: research, inventory, dependency analysis, regression preparation, and reversible shadow moves may run in parallel where ownership is disjoint, while ADR-0562 capability-move application and admission remain one capability per protected PR at a time until amended by later Accepted authority.

Treat communications, mail, messaging, notifications, and collaboration as composable interaction modes over governed context rather than permanent channel-shaped end-user product silos, while preserving the Accepted ADR-0615 multi-channel comms substrate and its capability boundary.

Grant autonomous repository and protected-PR execution authority for migrations, merges, deletions, amendments, and technical decisions, using a sixteen-lens council method and optimizing for final product quality, maintainability, long-term architecture, and engineering excellence.

Run planning research, reorganization analysis, feature discovery and preparation, tangent investigation, verification, testing, repair, and admission as a concurrent pipeline, while serializing shared authority and promotion.

Use a game-engine mental model for Oyatie's ontology, workflow, and no-code platform: revisioned world/state; stable entities; composable components and traits; explicit systems; durable events; business, effective, processing, and simulation time; deterministic preview and replay; scenes and views as projections; a visual world editor; multi-user tenancy; policy gates; save/load/audit; compensation and rollback; and dependency-aware scheduling.

Treat types as first-class tenant, pack, or platform definitions: extensible, customizable, configurable, no-code, composed rather than closed vendor enums, versioned and content-addressed, visually authored to canonical IR, template/default/constraint capable, policy-bound, compatibility-classified, previewable, and reversibly migratable or explicitly approved when irreversible.
Do not reduce legal authority, privacy, accounting, distributed consistency, irreversible external effects, or human accountability to game state.

founder_execution_authorization.source: direct founder directive in Codex task 019f80ef-bf93-77c2-a817-7bf77ee2f25c at 2026-07-21T19:36:22Z
founder_execution_authorization.scope: Oyatie repository, isolated worktrees, branches, protected pull requests, current documentation and decision surfaces, source and test code, generated-face producers, migration artifacts, and ordinary GitHub admission state placed in scope by the active goal.
authorized_actions: make autonomous technical, architectural, sequencing, migration, maintenance, and repository-organization decisions
create, amend, supersede, migrate, or delete code, tests, specs, documentation, registries, and decision proposals when evidence supports the change
repair, review, push, merge, close, or supersede pull requests and branches through protected admission
perform exact-target destructive repository changes when deletion is the correct long-term outcome and Git history plus protected receipts preserve recovery

parallelize disjoint migration research, inventory, regression preparation, reversible shadow moves, and evidence lanes while serializing shared authority, generated projections, dependency order, protected merge admission, and ADR-0562 capability-move application one capability per protected PR
continue without routine founder intervention until a qualified terminal outcome or irreducible external authority blocker
quality_order: maintainability, testability, simplicity, and deletion of accidental complexity
interoperability, portability, reversibility, and ecosystem health
reliability, observability, operations, cost, capacity, and energy
delivery speed after the preceding constraints are satisfied
founder_execution_authorization.destructive_change_rule: Resolve exact targets and dependencies read-only first; prefer deletion over misleading archives or compatibility fossils; preserve recovery in Git history; use regression-first proof, signed commits, protected exact-head review, green oya-ci-required, and post-merge receipts.
founder_execution_authorization.authority_boundary: This authorization removes the need for routine permission handoffs inside the stated scope. It does not manufacture independent evidence, appoint a qualified legal or affected-party principal, grant external credentials not already available, waive safety or repository policy, turn advisory agents into qualified humans, or by itself set PASS(Planning) or dispatch an implementation roadmap.
founder_execution_authorization.hold_interaction: Engineering, evidence, cleanup, admission, and migration-enabling work may proceed autonomously in the active gate sequence. HOLD(Planning) remains controlling until every Stage-1 entry requirement is independently satisfied and the qualified terminal authority issues PASS(Planning).

parallel_lanes: non-binding planning research and evidence collection
reorganization inventory, dependency analysis, migration design, and regression preparation
feature discovery, specification candidates, prototypes, and isolated implementation preparation
adjacent or tangent investigation that can change a decision or retire risk
verification, testing, adversarial review, repair, and exact-receipt production
protected admission of work already authorized by current Accepted authority
serialization_points: shared authority or canonical contract changes
dependency-order transitions and ADR-0562 capability-move application one capability per protected PR
concurrency_pipeline.promotion_barrier: Before qualified PASS(Planning), concurrent roadmap, reorganization, and new-feature work remains non-binding and isolated unless independently authorized by an already-Accepted decision. It cannot amend the controlling roadmap, become implementation dispatch, or merge a new unratified product direction into dev. After PASS(Planning), an independently approved roadmap may dispatch these lanes continuously with promotion serialized only where their contracts overlap.

pipeline_evolution_contract.outcome: Treat the engineering and delivery pipeline as a versioned platform product that continuously improves safe throughput, evidence quality, developer experience, release reliability, recovery, and user outcomes without optimizing away its own controls.
pipeline_evolution_contract.implementation_claim_ceiling: This contract defines the required operating model and evaluation bar. It does not claim every mechanism is implemented, live, production-ready, or authoritative. Each capability remains target, proposed, scaffolded, advisory, or gap evidence unless its own current lifecycle authority and exact runtime receipts prove otherwise.
pipeline_evolution_contract.authority_rule: Current Accepted decisions and canonical root pointers govern pipeline behavior. Proposed, target, historical, generated, or merely implemented artifacts may supply bounded evidence and candidate ideas, but they do not become authority through use, test success, repetition, or agent inference. Any disagreement between lifecycle metadata, prose, implementation, live protection, and generated projections becomes a chronology or corpus finding and fails closed at the applicable claim boundary.

work_graph_contract.scheduling_rule: Execute the dependency graph continuously: run ready, disjoint, reversible lanes concurrently; serialize by explicit dependency, shared path, authority, generated projection, integration candidate, or rollout boundary; and never infer readiness from queue position, age, or effort already spent.

closed_loop: observe outcomes, queues, failures, toil, misses, and user or service impact
form a bounded hypothesis with owner, affected population, expected benefit, risk, and stop condition
capture a reproducible baseline and immutable candidate inputs
add regression or policy tests before changing behavior
evaluate the change in isolated, shadow, or replay conditions
obtain independent adversarial and maintainability review
admit the exact candidate through protected policy
expand exposure progressively with predeclared signals and automatic stop or rollback
verify the stable outcome and unintended effects
record learning, retire ineffective complexity, and create owned preventive actions
pipeline_evolution_contract.parallelism_rule: Research, non-binding planning, graph analysis, affected-set computation, hermetic build and test shards, policy evaluation, provenance generation, migration preparation, isolated feature preparation, preproduction checks, and incident evidence collection may run concurrently when their inputs, ownership, authority, and side effects are disjoint.
pipeline_evolution_contract.serialization_rule: Shared authority, canonical-contract change, dependency-graph transition, generated projection, integration-candidate creation, protected admission, rollout expansion, rollback, and changes to pipeline controls serialize at their governing boundary. ADR-0562 capability moves additionally remain one capability per protected pull request even when their inventories, tests, and shadow plans are prepared in parallel.
pipeline_evolution_contract.lifecycle_graph_rule: Build, test, admission, artifact production, deployment preparation, and developer-environment verification project from one declared dependency and action graph. Runners and external systems are thin adapters; no runner may gain authority by reimplementing a narrower command subset or omitting a required graph edge.
pipeline_evolution_contract.generated_artifact_rule: Generated faces are projections, never hand-edited authority. Every face declares its source, schema, producer, consumer, and lifecycle as either tracked or not-tracked-in-git. Change the human-owned source, schema, or producer; materialize through the registered controller before consumption; require independent regenerate-twice determinism and byte or declared semantic parity; reject stale, unregistered, manually altered, or re-tracked decommitted faces; and preserve exact source-to-output provenance. Parallelize disjoint face generation; serialize only the shared source, producer, registry, or output boundary rather than imposing a blanket global generation lock.
pipeline_evolution_contract.trusted_control_rule: The candidate revision is untrusted data under test. Required-check definitions, policy and severity data, exception policy, trusted clocks, reviewer qualification, credentials, and admission mappings must come from a protected control state that the candidate cannot weaken, delete, replace, or self-approve. A candidate that changes a control is evaluated under the prior protected control and under the proposed successor before that successor can govern later candidates.
pipeline_evolution_contract.impact_rule: Affected-set verification is derived from semantic symbols or typed artifact pointers plus the declared build, contract, policy, data, and runtime dependency graphs. Unknown, unowned, incomplete, conflicting, deleted, graph-changing, or stale impact evidence broadens verification to the applicable full universe or blocks; it never narrows the test claim. Integration and protected-dev candidates receive full-graph validation, and measured misses or over-selection feed the next policy revision.
pipeline_evolution_contract.demand_driven_execution_rule: Each requested face or action evaluates only its declared transitive dependency slice, including declared policy, control, and input edges. The declared graph is the authority for reachability; no runner may eagerly compute unrelated faces as a prerequisite. Unknown, undeclared, incomplete, stale, conflicting, or graph-changing dependencies broaden evaluation to the applicable full universe or block; they never silently bypass a required dependency, narrow the claim, or mint a cache or admission result.
pipeline_evolution_contract.node_face_resource_evidence_contract: For every executed node, requested face, and action, retain a typed, redacted evidence row bound to the exact subject, declared dependency slice, runner, environment, and attempt. Record cold and warm wall time, user and system CPU, max RSS, input bytes and bytes scanned, cache state, key identity, hit/miss and invalidation reason as applicable, I/O, queue wait and contention, and deterministic output hash or an explicit non-determinism classification with its claim ceiling. Measurements are evidence for capacity, correctness, and evolution; no numeric threshold is implied, and absent, malformed, or incomparable evidence cannot silently support a performance, cache, or admission claim.
pipeline_evolution_contract.test_and_evidence_rule: Select unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, property, fuzz, security, privacy, accessibility, migration, rollback, and operational exercises from changed semantics, affected populations, risk, and claims. Every required tier records the command or method, runner, immutable inputs, environment, result, freshness, and artifacts; a rerun cannot convert a persistent failure into a pass, and a quarantine requires a scoped owner, expiry, evidence, and retirement condition.
pipeline_evolution_contract.failure_taxonomy_rule: Classify code regression, policy violation, security or privacy finding, stale or invalid evidence, infrastructure failure, suspected flake, cancellation, and timeout separately. Preserve the first failing evidence, do not relabel infrastructure red as candidate green, and require a reproducible cause or bounded quarantine before a later attempt can supersede an earlier result.
pipeline_evolution_contract.diagnosability_rule: Every run emits a typed, redacted, retained evidence packet that binds the exact subject, base, merge-base, attempt, phases, findings, artifact references, failure taxonomy, and reproduction path. First diagnosis must not depend on scraping ephemeral console logs or private tribal knowledge, and status projections never become a second merge authority.

automation_safety_governor.AUTO: Permitted only when deterministic, behavior-preserving, mechanically falsifiable, reversible, idempotent, reviewable, self-validating, and bounded by pre-image rollback. The detector and pure remediation proposal share one semantic kernel; applying writes is a separate least-privilege adapter. Automation may open a signed, exact, reviewable proposal but may never merge it, bypass a gate, self-approve, widen a baseline, or silently change authority.
automation_safety_governor.ADVISE: Use for semantics-changing or judgment-bearing proposals. The system may explain, simulate, compare, and prepare an exact candidate, but an independently authorized principal decides whether it stands.
automation_safety_governor.GATE: Use for irreversible or high-blast-radius effects, security, trust, access, money, rights, legal duties, one-way doors, unproven false-positive rates, or qualified judgment. Default to hold or refusal until the required authority and evidence exist.
automation_safety_governor.classification_rule: Every finding and remediation class has exactly one versioned tier as policy data. Safety decides the tier; convenience, implementation ease, frequency, or agent confidence does not. Promotion to a more autonomous tier requires a labeled corpus, zero unresolved safety failures, and independent exact-policy review.

pipeline_evolution_contract.exception_rule: A waiver, baseline, break-glass path, VEX statement, accepted risk, or temporary exclusion is scoped to immutable subjects and finding identities and carries a qualified owner and approver, rationale, compensating controls, issue and expiry times from a trusted clock, review cadence, audit receipt, and tested expiry behavior. Candidate-authored wildcard suppressions, permanent grants, silent skips, expired records, or same-candidate baseline growth fail closed.
pipeline_evolution_contract.security_and_supply_chain_rule: Security applicability is derived from subject and service classifications; unknown applicability is blocking. Scanner or model output is untrusted evidence until normalized into typed findings tied to immutable source, artifact, tool and ruleset versions. Applicable artifacts carry dependency resolution, signed provenance, and SBOM or an explicit non-applicability reason; vulnerable, unsigned, ambiguous, stale, or exception-dependent artifacts follow the versioned severity and admission policy rather than a raw tool exit code.
pipeline_evolution_contract.continuous_vulnerability_invalidation_ru: As a target operating invariant, a fresh vulnerability, compromised dependency or builder, revoked signature, changed exploitability assessment, expired VEX or waiver, or materially changed threat model re-evaluates already admitted and stable artifacts. The result may hold further promotion, quarantine distribution, require mitigation, trigger bounded rollback, or block continued operation according to separately ratified policy. This clause does not claim the current Proposed vulnerability-intelligence pipeline is live authority.
pipeline_evolution_contract.tenant_pipeline_isolation_rule: Pipeline identity, credentials and secrets, runners, workspaces, caches, artifacts, logs and evidence, release ledgers, deploy targets, status callbacks, and audit events are tenant-scoped and default-deny across tenant boundaries. Negative cross-tenant fixtures, least-privilege workload identities, tenant-scoped encryption and retention, and tenant-scoped expiring break-glass receipts are required before an isolation claim; the present contract does not claim those Phase-0 gaps are closed.
pipeline_evolution_contract.merge_and_release_separation: Merge admission proves only that the exact integration candidate satisfies repository policy. It does not prove runtime readiness. Runtime promotion separately requires an immutable artifact, environment and configuration identity, preproduction evidence, progressive cohorts, SLO and error-budget signals, observation windows, automatic stop or rollback, operational ownership, and post-promotion verification.
pipeline_evolution_contract.runtime_promotion_fail_closed_rule: Every admitted artifact begins runtime evaluation in held, not eligible. Eligibility is a deterministic, non-LLM decision over fresh live evidence and independently controlled policy. Missing, stale, unparseable, inconclusive, evaluator-unavailable, replay-only, synthetic, or backfilled evidence remains held and cannot mint promotion authority; later valid evidence may supersede it only through a new attributable receipt.
pipeline_evolution_contract.current_protected_admission_rule: While plain Git and protected GitHub pull requests remain the current substrate, a candidate may merge only when it is based on the current protected target, signed, conflict-free, independently reviewed at the exact head, free of unresolved review threads, and green in the single required oya-ci-required context. Merge state is serialized and re-read immediately before admission; any head, base, policy, review, or required-check change invalidates prior admission evidence.
pipeline_evolution_contract.post_merge_closure_rule: A merge receipt is not product completion. Bind the promoted commit to required-context readback, rollout or explicit non-runtime scope, rollback or reversion path, observability and user-story evidence where applicable, release-governance impact, and preventive-learning or duplicate disposition. State the exact claim ceiling and keep downstream roadmap or readiness claims blocked unless their independent evidence contracts are satisfied.
pipeline_evolution_contract.resource_lineage_and_health_rule: Every data source, transform, model, function, policy, agent, action, artifact, deployment, schedule, sync, and user-facing outcome participates in one typed, versioned lineage graph from source to effect and realized outcome. Classify source, input, intermediate, output, user-facing, and sink roles and derive schema, content, freshness, build, schedule, sync, latency, error, and outcome health from the declared graph and user expectation. The dynamically scoped monitoring follows additions, removals, ownership, permissions, and dependency changes; orphaned, unowned, or unmonitored material resources block the applicable readiness claim. Alerts bind severity, affected population, owner, runbook, diagnosis evidence, noise budget, and resolution receipt. A health projection is evidence and does not become authority or silently authorize promotion.
pipeline_evolution_contract.probabilistic_evaluation_rule: Deterministic, statistical, agentic, and model-backed components use versioned evaluation suites over a frozen population with expected outcomes, refusal and recourse cases, repeated runs and variance, baselines, confidence and calibration where applicable, and exact model, prompt, tool, data, policy, and evaluator versions. Results remain disaggregated for safety, privacy, accessibility, subgroup and affected-party outcomes and preserve failures, inconclusive cases, evaluator disagreement, and drift. A passing evaluation never establishes authority, erases Accepted ADR-0219's draft-only model-output boundary, or substitutes for independent policy, legal, affected-party, operational, or runtime-promotion evidence.
candidate_evidence_minimum: immutable source, current base, merge-base, and integration revisions
owner, scope, risk class, and affected-set result
resolved dependencies, toolchain, build definition, and output digests
test, policy, security, privacy, supply-chain, and quality results
software bill of materials and verifiable provenance where applicable
rollout blast radius, signals, observation window, stop conditions, and known-good rollback target
issuer identities, claim ceiling, freshness, invalidation events, and reproduction method
health_measures: lead time and deployment frequency interpreted as trends rather than individual or team scorecards
change-failure rate, restore time, rollback success, and repeated-failure rate
queue age, review latency, flaky-test rate, cache correctness, and hermeticity failures
affected-set miss and over-selection rates plus full-graph reconciliation
false-green, false-red, control-escape, expired-exception, and stale-evidence rates
pipeline availability, cost, capacity, energy, and recovery from control-plane failure
developer task success, toil, cognitive load, and time to safe independent use
user outcome, safety, privacy, accessibility, recourse, cost, and operational-impact measures
pipeline_evolution_contract.pipeline_slo_rule: Version pipeline service-level objectives for availability, queue and execution latency, evidence durability, correctness, false-green and false-red escape rates, cache and graph integrity, admission recovery, and control-plane disaster recovery. Use error budgets to change exposure and repair priority; never spend them to bypass a safety, legal, custody, or authority gate.
pipeline_evolution_contract.capacity_rule: Run the maximum safe useful concurrency derived from the ready work graph, disjoint ownership, dependency and rollout boundaries, reviewer and custody capacity, compute and cost budgets, and failure-domain isolation. Raw worker utilization, queue length, or idle capacity is not itself success; overload, review starvation, correlated failure, and control-plane saturation reduce concurrency automatically.
pipeline_evolution_contract.measurement_use_rule: Pipeline measures are system-level learning signals and claim evidence. They must not be used as individual or team productivity rankings, promotion targets, or incentives that reward bypassing quality, safety, accessibility, privacy, recourse, documentation, or long-term maintainability.
pipeline_evolution_contract.learning_rule: Incidents, near misses, failed changes, false greens, false reds, rollbacks, security findings, affected-set misses, and experiments produce attributable preventive actions with an owner, due condition, verification method, and later effectiveness check. Narrative alone is not closure; ineffective actions are revised or deleted, and obsolete mechanisms are removed from readable authority rather than archived beside current truth.
pipeline_evolution_contract.research_rule: Before material pipeline changes, read the current controlling Oyatie authorities and fresh primary official sources relevant to the mechanism, record versions, retrieval times, scope, digests where permitted, limitations, and observed-versus-inferred claims, and keep external documentation as evidence rather than repository authority.

research_basis.claim_boundary: These official sources are external evidence for the operating-model candidate. They do not override Oyatie authority, prove implementation, or authorize a roadmap. Revalidate the applicable sources before a material pipeline amendment.

sources.scope: reproducible hermetic builds, intentional release-process change, review, serial and parallel workflow steps, progressive rollout, rollback, and exact release identity
sources.adoption: Use lifecycle-wide reproducibility, explicit policy, graph-derived parallelism, and risk-shaped rollout without copying Google-specific tooling.

sources.scope: queryable target graphs, remote-execution-first actions, multi-language composition, incremental actions, and one dynamic dependency graph that permits precise invalidation and cross-phase parallelism
sources.adoption: Keep Buck2 as the current declared build-graph substrate and derive impact and parallel execution from explicit graph facts; do not treat any runner command or cache hit as independent admission authority.

sources.scope: small changes, automated build/test/deploy, canary-control comparison, SLO and error-budget decisions, measurement, and rollback
sources.adoption: Separate merge evidence from runtime exposure and expand only through predeclared measurements, stop conditions, and retained results.

sources.scope: approved source and build tracks, provenance production, distribution, verification, and platform assessment
sources.adoption: Bind source and artifact identities to verifiable provenance; treat SLSA level claims as separately evidenced rather than implied.

sources.scope: build and SBOM attestations bound to artifact subjects and digests, permission-scoped issuance, storage, and later verification
sources.adoption: Use attestations only as one substrate-specific provenance carrier behind Oyatie's provider-neutral evidence contract; require independent verification and never infer readiness from attestation presence alone.

sources.scope: least-privilege workflow credentials, untrusted pull-request data, third-party action risk, secret exposure, and automation-created or automation-approved pull-request risk
sources.adoption: Keep candidate code and workflow artifacts untrusted, minimize token scope, isolate privileged evaluation, and prevent automation from creating its own independent approval or bypass path.

sources.scope: secure-development practices integrated into each SDLC, vulnerability reduction, impact mitigation, root-cause prevention, and supplier communication
sources.adoption: Integrate security across the work graph and learning loop instead of attaching a scanner-only terminal step.

sources.scope: policy-as-code for repository, configuration, supply-chain, coverage, test-selection, and job-dependency checks
sources.adoption: Keep policy decisions versioned and testable while preserving Oyatie's owned engine, trusted-control, and no-tool-as-authority boundaries.

sources.scope: declarative in-process admission policy, bindings, validation actions, audit and warning modes, match conditions, and failure policy
sources.adoption: Use staged policy evaluation and explicit failure behavior as a reference pattern; do not equate cluster admission with repository or legal authority.

sources.scope: background and inline analysis, success and failure conditions, retention, inconclusive outcomes, experiments, pause, and abort
sources.adoption: Model runtime promotion as typed progressive exposure with explicit success, failure, inconclusive, pause, abort, and retention semantics.

sources.scope: managed rollout readiness, failure-triggered rollback, no-wait iteration modes, scoped readiness timeouts, and image pre-pulling
sources.adoption: Use Apollo only as a minimum comparative baseline for explicit readiness, timeout, and rollback semantics; Oyatie must remain provider-neutral, evidence-typed, policy-governed, and measurably better on matched journeys rather than copying Apollo's product or manifest shape.

sources.scope: data-quality foundations, governed project structure, batch, incremental, and streaming pipeline choices, unit tests, branching, release, scheduling, and health checks
sources.adoption: Use as a minimum baseline for lifecycle-complete data-pipeline hygiene; Oyatie extends the graph through authority, policy, evidence, decisions, actions, recourse, runtime exposure, and realized outcomes rather than copying Foundry project or product structure.

sources.scope: reusable parameters and custom functions, large-graph grouping, job and compute-profile grouping, checkpoints, selective visibility, and sampled previews
sources.adoption: Use as a minimum usability and compute-efficiency baseline while requiring one typed IR, semantic-preserving multiple views, full-population admission evidence, graph-derived concurrency, explicit authority, and portable non-vendor execution.

sources.scope: interactive discovery of datasets, ancestors and descendants, schema, build freshness, producing code, shared snapshots, and lineage visualization
sources.adoption: Use data lineage as a minimum visibility baseline; Oyatie requires continuous source-to-observation-to-decision-to-authorized-action-to-outcome lineage with corrections, uncertainty, authority, custody, privacy, and recourse preserved.

sources.scope: scope-aware monitoring views, fine-grained resource health checks, dynamic coverage as resources change, alerting, and integration with operational response systems
sources.adoption: Use as a minimum resource-health baseline while requiring typed ownership, affected populations, outcome health, evidence freshness, noise budgets, diagnosis and recovery receipts, and fail-closed readiness for unowned or unmonitored material resources.

sources.scope: evaluation suites, target and evaluation functions, test cases, per-case and aggregate metrics, version comparison, model comparison, and variance across repeated runs
sources.adoption: Use as a minimum nondeterministic-evaluation baseline while preserving exact populations, disaggregated affected-party outcomes, refusal and recourse cases, evaluator disagreement, drift, draft-only model outputs, and a strict separation between evaluation evidence and authority.

sources.scope: conceptual product release units spanning multiple repositories and resources, protected production branches, development and feature branches, end-user verification, and retained collaboration evidence
sources.adoption: Use only as comparative release-process evidence; Oyatie retains one hyperscale monorepo, current plain-Git protected-PR admission, exact-head review, one required status, graph-derived impact, and independent runtime promotion rather than copying GitFlow or Foundry branch semantics.

sources.scope: learning from failure through blameless analysis and tracked preventive actions
sources.adoption: Require attributable preventive actions and later effectiveness checks without using incident learning as personal performance scoring.

sources.scope: voluntary, rights-preserving governance, mapping, measurement, and management of AI risk
sources.adoption: Keep agent and model outputs advisory evidence unless a versioned safety and authority contract promotes the exact use.

sources.scope: queued pull-request retesting against the latest target branch and branch-protection compatibility
sources.adoption: Use only as comparative evidence for integration-candidate freshness; it does not claim a live Oyatie merge queue or replace ADR-0515 protected admission.

pipeline_evolution_contract.productization_and_portability_rule: Keep reusable engine and contract semantics separate from repository-specific policy packs, credentials, host adapters, and tenant configuration. Independently version and digest the engine, policy pack, schema, runner adapter, toolchain, and evidence format; declare compatibility and migration; reproduce the decision from a fresh checkout and immutable inputs; and require equivalence evidence before a runner or host cutover. Support hermetic local, CI, deployment, and development-environment execution from the same declared graph, and avoid making any vendor, UI, CLI, or hosted control plane the only way to reproduce a decision.
pipeline_evolution_contract.pipeline_migration_rule: Every pipeline replacement declares old and new authorities, compatibility and data migration, dual-run or shadow comparison where safe, cutover and rollback conditions, consumer migration, observation window, and deletion criteria. After verified cutover, remove the retired mechanism and its readable authority surfaces rather than maintaining an ambiguous archive or permanent compatibility path.
pipeline_evolution_contract.self_modification_boundary: Automation may propose, implement in isolation, test, replay, and recommend pipeline changes. It may not self-approve or silently modify required checks, policy or credential authority, evidence semantics, branch protection, bypass rules, rollback authority, legal or qualified-human gates, or this boundary. Such changes require independent exact-candidate review, versioned authority, dual evaluation under the prior and proposed policies, staged exposure, and a tested recovery path.

durable_goal.north_star: Enable people and organizations to describe, understand, coordinate, simulate, and safely improve real-world activity without writing code, while Oyatie continuously preserves the authorized context, evidence, history, policy, and responsibility required to turn intent into trustworthy outcomes.
durable_goal.outcome: Difficult, tedious, fragmented work that currently requires teams of analysts, operators, integrators, administrators, and coordinators becomes a governed, explainable, continuously updated operational capability available to the person who needs it at the moment of decision.
durable_goal.quality_bar: The system must be more intuitive, more continuous, more interoperable, more explainable, and safer to act through than the relevant alternatives under matched user journeys and conditions. No superiority claim is valid without a bounded comparator population and independent measurements.
durable_goal.scope: Business-to-consumer and machine-to-human continuity across cloud, developer, enterprise, and consumer domains, including the data, workflow, policy, identity, communication, analytics, automation, and recourse needed for end-to-end outcomes.
durable_goal.time_horizon: indefinite product direction; versioned as understanding and qualified evidence improve

game_engine_product_model.status: founder-intent-only; non-binding until independently reviewed and ratified
game_engine_product_model.purpose: Use game-engine concepts as a product-design mental model for a governed operational world, not as a claim that Oyatie is a game, a chosen implementation architecture, or a roadmap dispatch.
world_contract: Model a revisioned world/state through stable entities, composable components and traits, explicit systems, and durable events.
Represent business, effective, processing, and simulation time explicitly; preserve their distinctions rather than deriving one silently from another.
Support deterministic preview and replay from declared inputs, versions, policies, and schedules, with uncertainty, external nondeterminism, and claim limits visible.
Treat scenes and views as contextual projections of governed state, and support a visual world editor that authors canonical representations rather than a separate opaque visual truth.
Support multi-user and tenant-scoped worlds, policy gates, save/load/audit, compensation and rollback where technically possible, and dependency-aware scheduling.

type_contract.rule: Types are first-class tenant, pack, or platform definitions, not a closed vendor enum or code-only implementation detail.
requirements: extensible, customizable, configurable, and no-code capable
composed from stable definitions, components, traits, templates, defaults, and constraints rather than closed vendor enums
visually authored to canonical IR with round-trip traceability
reversibly migratable, or explicitly approved with a stated irreversible boundary, affected population, recourse, and rollback or compensation limit
future_accepted_successor_requirements: Stable logical EntityId and TypeId remain distinct from immutable revision digests; external aliases and merge, split, and rekey history remain explicit.
Component applicability, cardinality, precedence, conflict handling, and cycle detection are declared and fail closed when incomplete or conflicting.
Commands, decisions, events, observations, corrections, projections, and effects remain explicit distinct kinds rather than one overloaded record.
Preview is isolated from live effects and declares its clock, randomness, external I/O, uncertainty, and non-effect boundary.
Projections are rebuildable and non-authoritative; visual writes compile to canonical IR and declare round-trip loss.
Defaults retain provenance, templates create candidates rather than authority, and constraint conflicts fail closed.
Compatibility is classified independently across producer, consumer, stored-data, UI, policy, and authority boundaries.
Migrations freeze the affected population and require coexistence, dry-run, checkpoints, partial-failure recovery, refusal, and verification.
Unknown extensions are preserved where possible and every semantic loss is explicitly disclosed.
These are future Accepted-successor requirements only; they select no implementation, architecture, data model, framework, or roadmap.

hard_limits: Legal authority is established by qualified principals and applicable law, never by a world-state transition.
Privacy, consent, purpose limitation, retention, residency, and deletion constraints bind the world model and cannot be reduced to state.
Accounting requires independently governed records, controls, reconciliation, and accountable sign-off; simulation or replay does not establish a financial fact.
Distributed consistency limits, partial failure, and external concurrency require explicit semantics; a deterministic local replay does not prove global consistency.
Irreversible external effects require separately established authority, policy, confirmation, and recourse; they are not made reversible by representation.
Human accountability, affected-party rights, explanation, approval, appeal, remedy, and legal recourse remain human and institutional obligations, not game mechanics.
non_claims: No game-engine framework, ECS implementation, rendering stack, data model, or roadmap is selected by this intent.
No implementation, migration, dispatch, production-readiness, determinism, or reversibility claim is made by this intent.

stage1_entry_requirements.authority_status: non-dispatching founder requirement vocabulary; no control is satisfied or assigned an owner by this artifact
stage1_entry_requirements.namespace_rule: These identifiers name product-intent entry requirements only. They are not masterplan work-item IDs, do not amend specs/masterplan.json, and become binding only through a separately reviewed closure contract admitted under current authority.

receipt_contract.binding_rule: A satisfied decision is valid only when every required field is present, every referenced digest reproduces, the owner and reviewer are qualified and independent under an already-ratified policy, and no invalidation event has occurred.
receipt_contract.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, unverifiable, stale, self-appointed, author-only, group-only, or context-dependent evidence yields unknown or unsatisfied; it never yields satisfied.
receipt_contract.aggregation_rule: Planning entry is the conjunction of all fifteen independently satisfied controls at one frozen candidate digest. A summary, group status, majority, or inferred pass cannot substitute for an atomic receipt.

controls.acceptance: Every controlling decision has a corpus-qualified identity, coherent lifecycle and supersession edges, an explicit disposition, and no unresolved Accepted-authority conflict for the frozen candidate.
controls.required_evidence: complete decision census, lifecycle graph, conflict ledger, source-path manifest, immutable successor receipts, and independently reproduced digests
controls.freshness: invalidated by any governed decision-corpus, lifecycle, identity, or candidate-digest change

controls.required_evidence: regression corpus, parser and IR versions, parse census, mutation tests, projection parity, and exact source/output digests
controls.freshness: invalidated by parser, grammar, IR, projection producer, governed corpus, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: The complete active authority corpus is enumerated, current projections reproduce, superseded authority is absent from every readable path, and provenance exists only in Git history where history-only retirement applies.

controls.freshness: maximum age 24 hours and invalidated by any tracked-path, generated-face policy, corpus, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: Every decision, participant role, journey class, authority holder, dependency, exception, and unresolved question in scope belongs to a frozen denominator with no silent exclusions.
controls.required_evidence: population definition, inclusion and exclusion rules, completeness tests, orphan report, denominator digest, and independent census review
controls.freshness: invalidated by population, scope, corpus, scenario, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: A qualified legal or JCR authority has issued a scope-specific written disposition for every external source, benchmark use, data handling, and proposed evidence-retention action.
controls.required_evidence: qualified principal identity, exact terms and source digests, use scope, restrictions, decision, effective time, expiry or review triggers, and protected receipt
controls.freshness: invalidated by terms, source, jurisdiction, intended use, retention, distribution, or candidate-digest change
controls.qualified_owner_status: unresolved; this artifact makes no legal conclusion

controls.acceptance: Outcome-based comparisons cover the frozen scenario population across all continuity domains without copying a comparator taxonomy, feature list, implementation, or product shape.
controls.required_evidence: source inventory, retrieval timestamps, content digests, observed-inferred-unknown labels, matched conditions, measures, limitations, evaluator independence, and claim ledger
controls.freshness: maximum age 30 days and invalidated by source, comparator version, scenario, measure, legal scope, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: Affected parties and vulnerable populations are represented across routine, denied, erroneous, hostile, appealed, and recovery journeys, with independently reviewed notice, consent, privacy, fairness, accommodation, and recourse outcomes.
controls.required_evidence: frozen affected-party population, accessible research protocol, dissent, harms and benefits ledger, mitigations, unresolved objections, and signed review receipts
controls.freshness: maximum age 30 days and invalidated by scenario, population, policy, risk, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: Qualified operators can observe, contain, recover, roll back, reconcile, and support the frozen journeys under normal, degraded, disconnected, emergency, and hostile conditions without hidden manual authority.
controls.required_evidence: operating model, ownership and escalation, SLO and budget assumptions, runbooks, failure exercises, observability receipts, rollback and reconciliation proof, and operator sign-off
controls.freshness: invalidated by operating model, dependency, deployment, pilot, runbook, risk, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: Every authority-bearing identity, credential, key, token, consent, delegation, and evidence store has qualified custody, immutable principal binding, least privilege, rotation, revocation, recovery, and separation of duties.
controls.required_evidence: principal and custodian IDs, custody policy digest, ceremony or issuance receipt, access graph, rotation and revocation test, compromise recovery, and independent readback
controls.freshness: invalidated immediately by principal, custodian, credential, key, policy, access, rotation, revocation, incident, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: Named qualified principals can stop unsafe planning admission or downstream action through an independently exercised, observable, durable, and non-retaliatory veto path.
controls.required_evidence: ratified veto policy, immutable principal IDs, scope and conflict rules, exercise and appeal simulation, audit receipt, and recovery from a vetoed candidate
controls.freshness: invalidated by policy, principal, scope, escalation, appeal, exercise result, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: A bounded, ethically and legally cleared pilot over a frozen participant and scenario population demonstrates safe value, failure handling, recourse, operator readiness, reversibility, and measurable outcomes without using the pilot to infer universal coverage.
controls.required_evidence: pilot protocol, approvals, participant and exclusion denominator, baselines, measures, incident and harms log, rollback, outcomes, dissent, and independent evaluation
controls.freshness: maximum age 90 days and invalidated by material product, scenario, population, policy, operating, legal, safety, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: A protected, content-addressed successor explicitly reconciles every controlling predecessor, changed outcome, removed outcome, open question, authority boundary, and dispatch prohibition under current ratified decision rights.
controls.required_evidence: predecessor and successor digests, disposition matrix, qualified ratifications, protected admission receipt, rollback or supersession rule, and reproducible history
controls.freshness: invalidated by successor bytes, predecessor set, ratification, authority policy, protected admission, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: A separately ratified sixteen-lens definition and qualified reviewer population produce sixteen independent, exact-candidate verdict receipts with conflicts, abstentions, minority views, and unresolved findings preserved.
controls.required_evidence: immutable lens definition, qualification and independence policy, reviewer population, one receipt per lens, conflict and abstention ledger, synthesis rule, and exact-candidate digest
controls.freshness: invalidated by lens, reviewer, qualification, independence, finding, resolution, synthesis, or candidate-digest change

controls.acceptance: A fresh qualified reviewer can start only from the canonical root pointers, reproduce the candidate, evidence graph, fifteen control states, unresolved issues, and terminal decision without this task, hidden context, or author interpretation.

controls.freshness: maximum age 7 days and invalidated by root pointer, corpus, toolchain, evidence, control state, candidate, or terminal-decision change

engineering_rules: Begin behavior changes with a regression that fails for the intended reason.
Use plain git, SSH-signed commits, protected pull requests against dev, exact-head review, the single oya-ci-required context, and exact post-merge receipts.
Do not invent legal, custody, operational, affected-party, veto, pilot, reviewer, council, dissent, exit, or founder authority.
Keep binding plan approval and implementation dispatch false until separately proven and ratified.
requested_terminal_outcomes: a candidate PASS(Planning) backed by independently satisfied control receipts, with implementation dispatch still false until a roadmap is separately approved and with issuance authority defined only by a later ratified closure contract
truthful blocker packet identifying the exact irreducible qualified-human role, decision, authority, receipt, freshness requirement, and verification path
stage1_entry_requirements.terminal_authority_rule: This founder-intent spec can request terminal outcomes but cannot issue them. PASS(Planning), if ever available, must be issued by a separately ratified immutable closure contract under current decision rights.

advisory_16_lens_council.status: founder-directed advisory decision method; pending separate Stage-1 definition, qualification, independence, population, and ratification
advisory_16_lens_council.use_rule: Every material plan, migration, deletion, architecture amendment, feature, capability, or admission decision must be challenged through all sixteen lenses against one frozen candidate. Findings, abstentions, conflicts, assumptions, uncertainty, dissent, and dispositions remain visible.
advisory_16_lens_council.decision_rule: The method seeks a coherent synthesis, not a feature-count vote. A hard safety, authority, legal, evidence, custody, operability, or context-free blocker cannot be outvoted. Advisory agent findings can improve engineering decisions but cannot satisfy a gate that requires an independent qualified human or institution.

lenses.question: Does the change improve named participant outcomes and the typed no-code operational-world-model north star without adding orphan capability?
Can intended users succeed with minimal training across accessibility, language, device, connectivity, novice, expert, and exception conditions?
Are identity, meaning, lineage, time, fact, inference, causality, forecast, decision, action, and outcome typed and kept distinct?

Does the change strengthen capability ownership, dependency direction, the distinct execution-profile and substrate-topology boundaries, hyperscale monorepo coherence, and freedom from mega-services or junk drawers?
Are consistency, idempotency, ordering, failure domains, degradation, recovery, rollback, reconciliation, and multi-region or disconnected behavior explicit?
Are principals, credentials, authority, least privilege, isolation, custody, revocation, compromise recovery, and supply-chain trust fail-closed?
Are purpose, minimization, consent, personal-work boundaries, retention, correction, deletion, residency, disclosure, and audit rights enforceable?
Are jurisdiction, terms, licenses, regulatory duties, records, external-source use, and qualified legal or JCR decisions explicit rather than inferred?
Are harms, vulnerable populations, notice, accommodation, fairness, human review, appeal, veto, compensation, and recovery represented by affected parties?
Is the solution understandable, testable, observable, documented, boring where possible, dependency-minimal, regression-locked, and sustainable for future teams?
Does the platform support strong tenancy, policy continuity, global and local operation, sovereignty, portability, capacity, and provider-grade lifecycle management?
Are unit economics, cost attribution, pricing, capacity, energy, operator burden, incentives, ecosystem viability, and long-term service sustainability visible?
Can the capability interoperate through open versioned contracts, preserve end-to-end business-to-consumer lineage, avoid lock-in, and coexist during incremental adoption?
Are dependency order, parallel lanes, compatibility windows, data and authority migration, deletion criteria, rollback, supersession, and operator communication safe?
How can the proposal be exploited, misunderstood, bypassed, corrupted, captured, or fail under hostile and crisis conditions, and what dissent remains unresolved?
Are populations, baselines, measures, comparator sources, digests, freshness, uncertainty, claim ceilings, audit receipts, and context-free reproduction sufficient?

advisory_16_lens_council.stage1_nonclaim: This taxonomy is the founder-directed advisory method for ongoing work. It is not the independently ratified and populated council_16_lens control receipt required for PASS(Planning).

product_model.category_boundary: Many real-world activities contain pipelines, workflows, and ingestion, but the universal model must also represent state machines, events, negotiations, commitments, policies, exceptions, uncertainty, human judgment, and reversible action. Boxes and arrows alone are insufficient.
operational_loop: detect change, anomaly, risk, and opportunity
recommend options with reasons and uncertainty

architectural_classification_mapping.rule: Cloud, developer, enterprise, and consumer are product continuity domains. Execution profiles, substrate topology, and capability ownership are orthogonal classifications and must not be collapsed. Every admitted outcome must state the applicable responsibilities and boundaries in each classification.

authority_status_map.rule: Use the E0, B0, C0, C1, C2, G, and R face-aware topology and keep cell runtime free of synchronous global-management dependency.
Use capability ownership with core, ports, adapters, and facade, preserve the multi-channel comms substrate, and apply capability moves one protected PR at a time.
Data classes forbidden from secondary-provider fallback remain unavailable and emit a lawful brownout rather than violating sovereignty.
No-egress operation requires in-cell registry, secrets, audit, telemetry, policy-supporting dependencies, update preparation, and recovery boundaries.

authority_status_map.topic: control, data, and analytics execution profiles
authority_status_map.rule: This vocabulary may classify candidates but cannot be represented as Accepted canonical plane authority unless chronology closure ratifies an immutable successor.

system_quality_invariants: One coherent experience and semantic contract without requiring one deployment, database, mega-service, or trust domain.
Tenant, organization, household, personal, device, and public boundaries remain explicit; cross-boundary continuity uses governed references and selective disclosure.
Global scale must coexist with sovereignty, residency, localization, accessibility, intermittent connectivity, and local or air-gapped operation.
Availability and automation degrade gracefully: stale, partial, denied, disconnected, and emergency states are modeled outcomes rather than hidden failures.

Every material effect declares delivery semantics, ordering and concurrency boundaries, retry identity, reconciliation ownership, idempotency or explicit non-idempotency, observability, attribution, compensation limits, and failure-domain bounds.
Execute-then-verify is prohibited for irreversible or externally non-compensatable effects unless a separately approved exception binds tested compensation, reconciliation, and stop conditions.
Open, versioned interfaces and portable semantic exports prevent lock-in and allow coexistence with existing systems during incremental adoption.
Cost, latency, energy, capacity, retention, and operational burden are first-class constraints, not post-hoc optimization concerns.
The same typed contract supports no-code users, expert operators, developers, and autonomous agents without giving any interface implicit authority.

Communications, mail, messaging, notifications, and collaboration are governed interaction modes over shared typed context, not permanent end-user product silos; Accepted ADR-0615's multi-channel comms substrate and capability boundary remain intact, and any package or repository migration remains separate ADR and roadmap work.
Schemas, policies, journeys, models, and automations evolve through explicit versions, compatibility rules, replay, migration, and rollback.
Security, privacy, safety, fairness, and recourse are product behavior and measurable outcomes, not documentation-only requirements.
portability_and_ecosystem_acceptance: import and export round-trip preserves supported semantics, identities, versions, lineage, policy references, evidence bindings, and declared loss
open conformance suites validate contract shape, behavior, error semantics, and integrity proofs without privileged internal knowledge
version negotiation and schema evolution declare compatibility, deprecation, migration, rollback, and refusal behavior
selective disclosure and provenance qualify unverifiable or conflicting external claims rather than promoting them to fact
revocation and compromise handling propagates across provider, dependency, tenant, and customer boundaries
successful ecosystem exit is measured by portable artifacts, data, configuration, evidence, obligations, and successor continuity

semantic_strata.covers: principals, entities, resources, relations, observations, events, typed state, context, and evidence
occurred, observed, recorded, and effective time; valid intervals; correction; supersession; ordering; and freshness
policy, contract, authority, delegation, consent, obligation, prohibition, jurisdiction, rights, and recourse
goals, requests, commitments, work, decisions, beneficiaries, and affected parties
actions, effects, workflows, handoffs, exceptions, compensation, inference, causality, forecasts, scenarios, optimization proposals, and outcomes

time_states.rule: Preserve versioned integrity and lineage for observations, transactions, decisions, contracts, corrections, and outcomes without assuming that source content must be retained forever. Corrections append or supersede with provenance. Lawful deletion may redact, irreversibly minimize, or cryptographically erase erasable content while retaining only the minimum lawful correction or deletion event and non-reconstructive digest; scoped, time-bounded legal holds are explicit exceptions.
Compute current state from explicit source versions and freshness. Show stale, partial, conflicting, late, or unavailable inputs rather than presenting them as current truth.

Keep forecasts, plans, scenarios, simulations, commitments, and optimization proposals distinguishable from observed facts. Every future view states assumptions, confidence, horizon, and invalidation conditions.

typed_artifacts.minimum: source principal or system, asserted content, subject, event, observed, recorded, and effective time where applicable, version, classification, purpose, retention and residency binding, and correction or deletion lineage
claimant, subject, asserted proposition, basis, event, observed, recorded, and effective time where applicable, confidence if supplied, corroboration status, dispute state, and provenance
as-of and computation time, source cutoff, projection version, freshness, unresolved late events, epistemic status, and derivation receipt
subjects, relation, inference rule or model, source snapshot, valid and recorded time, confidence, limitations, contradiction state, and evidence
explicit baseline, deviation, sensitivity, confidence, expected impact, and false-positive recourse
candidate cause and effect, temporal scope, mechanism, assumptions, plausible alternatives, disconfirming evidence, confidence, and test or decision boundary
qualified acceptance state, method, assumptions, confounders, counterfactual basis, temporal scope, confidence, limitations, reviewer, and supporting evidence
model and data snapshot, horizon, interval, calibration, assumptions, and invalidation conditions
declared assumptions, controlled changes, constraints, comparison baseline, and projected outcomes
proposed option, intended outcome, rationale, alternatives, evidence, uncertainty, affected parties, authority required, expiry, and recourse
objective, constraints, alternatives, predicted delta, tradeoffs, uncertainty, and required authority
principal, rationale, evidence, alternatives, affected parties, approvals, and appeal or reconsideration path
policy, delegation, consent, approval, idempotency, side effects, compensation, and audit receipt
realized effect linked to the proposal, decision, action, evidence, expected outcome, and discrepancy analysis

temporal_and_epistemic_contract.mapping_rule: Every knowledge class has exactly one explicit typed-artifact mapping in this contract. An artifact may reference another class but must not silently promote an assertion to fact, a hypothesis to causal claim, a recommendation to decision, or a decision to authorized action.
temporal_and_epistemic_contract.rule: The interface and APIs must never collapse different knowledge classes into one undifferentiated truth. Users must be able to see what is asserted, corroborated, inferred, hypothesized, accepted, uncertain, expected, decided, authorized, and verified; all material artifacts bind applicable valid, event, observed, recorded, and effective time.

experience_contract.primary_mode: Complete common and advanced user journeys must be buildable, operable, and understandable without writing code. Code is an optional extension surface, not a prerequisite for obtaining the promised outcomes.
visual_language: Use the representation best suited to the job: flow, timeline, graph, table, form, canvas, map, calendar, conversation, dashboard, or simulation.
One underlying semantic model must survive switching views without losing meaning, policy, lineage, or state.
Natural-language creation may accelerate configuration, but the resulting typed model, permissions, effects, and failure behavior must remain inspectable and editable visually.
Progressive disclosure must make simple consumer tasks simple without hiding the control required for complex enterprise operations.
Every automation must expose trigger, input, output, authority, policy, side effects, failure path, owner, and rollback or recourse.
usability_invariants: minimal or no training for the bounded target journey
safe preview, simulation, test data, and reversible publication

user control over notification timing, channel, sensitivity, and escalation

experience_contract.adoption_measurement_rule: Measure task success, error recovery, assistance, abandonment, and time to independent success across novice, expert, assistive-technology, language, device, connectivity, and brownfield-import cohorts; a launch demonstration cannot establish minimal-training or no-code lifecycle claims.

representative_scenarios.intent: Detect, refuse, contain, and recover from attempts to poison evidence, manipulate an affected set, compromise a migration manifest or codemod, spoof a dependency or required check, capture governance, or expand a cross-tenant blast radius.
required_outputs: candidate-bound provenance and independent reproduction of inputs, graph, policy, tests, generated projections, and outputs
fail-closed broadening when affected-set, identity, signature, dependency, or evidence state is unknown or inconsistent
separation of proposer, reviewer, policy issuer, credential custodian, promoter, and rollback authority
scoped containment and revocation that preserves forensic evidence and unaffected tenant operation
known-good restoration, rollback, replay, customer and affected-party notice, remedy, and verified recovery
fresh dissent and post-incident controls that cannot be suppressed by throughput or majority vote
hard_cases: cross-tenant compromise hidden by a narrow affected set

representative_scenarios.intent: Coordinate a disruption such as a delayed trip, recalled product, failed delivery, or unavailable supplier across organizations while preserving consent, obligations, alternatives, compensation, and recourse.
required_outputs: shared event and dependency context

participant_and_journey_census.rule: A universal or end-to-end claim is invalid until the relevant role, journey, variant, and coverage denominator is enumerated and independently evaluated.

intelligence_and_automation_contract.decision_rule: Automation level is constrained by actor authority, risk, reversibility, confidence, affected-party rights, policy, jurisdiction, and the cost of a false positive or false negative. Confidence never establishes authority. Under Accepted ADR-0219, model output remains draft-only and cannot activate or execute an effect; execution requires independently established principal authority, capability policy, and runtime enforcement. Every action contract declares delivery semantics, ordering and concurrency boundary, retry identity, reconciliation owner, timeout behavior, and compensation limits. Execute-then-verify is forbidden for irreversible or externally non-compensatable effects unless a separately approved exception has a tested compensation and reconciliation path.
explanation_minimum: what changed or is expected to change
which sources and versions support it
what authority and approval each option requires
how to correct, revoke, appeal, or recover
intelligence_and_automation_contract.learning_rule: Feedback may improve models, defaults, and recommendations only under consent, privacy, tenancy, provenance, evaluation, and rollback controls. Learning must not retroactively alter source history or silently expand authority.

requirements: source identity, capture time, event time, ingestion time, version, and jurisdiction
schema and semantic mapping with unresolved ambiguity visible
entity resolution with merge, split, and correction history
contract, policy, consent, purpose, retention, residency, and jurisdiction binding for each material data use rather than only for each source

late, duplicate, conflicting, missing, and retracted data handling
portable export, correction, redaction, irreversible minimization or cryptographic erasure, deletion, and legal-hold behavior that separates integrity evidence from retained content
scoped and time-bounded legal holds with qualified authority, review triggers, release, and downstream propagation
data_and_lineage_contract.real_time_rule: Real-time means fresh enough for the bounded decision and its risk, with explicit latency and staleness budgets. It does not mean pretending every source is instantaneous or complete.

invariants: workload and agent principals remain distinct from user sessions and bind tenant, environment, issuer, audience, purpose, scope, expiry, and revocation epoch

separation of duties for high-impact actions
preview, approval, veto, stop, rollback, and break-glass controls proportional to risk
auditability without turning Oyatie into a surveillance system
correction, dispute, appeal, revocation, and human recourse
fairness and accessibility evaluation for affected populations
secure failure that preserves evidence and avoids unauthorized action

affected_party_contract.representation_rule: Material journeys identify affected populations, power imbalances, conflicts of interest, and a legitimate representative independent of the proposing or benefiting party where representation is required. Advisory agents, generic role labels, and aggregate metrics are not affected-party representation.
minimum_rights: timely accessible notice through a safe channel
understandable reasons, material inputs, uncertainty, authority, and expected effects
an empowered pause, review, correction, veto, appeal, and emergency-stop path appropriate to risk
human review with authority to change the outcome
remedy, restitution, financial compensation where applicable, restoration, and verified recovery
privacy-preserving evidence access and independent advocacy
affected_party_contract.compensation_boundary: Technical saga compensation reverses or reconciles system effects; it is not a substitute for restitution, financial compensation, remedy, apology, restored access or opportunity, legal recourse, or verified affected-party recovery.
affected_party_contract.measurement_rule: Evaluate subgroup harm, disparate error and denial, notice comprehension, time and effort to obtain review, retaliation or abandonment, remedy completeness, restoration time, and recourse burden across the frozen affected population; averages cannot hide subgroup failure.

anti_goals: copying comparator features, implementation, information architecture, or proprietary content
building one mega-app, mega-schema, or mega-workflow graph
reducing every human activity to a linear pipeline
treating a node-and-edge canvas as the only interaction model
opaque scoring or autonomous action without inspectable reasons and authority
using AI output as authorization, legal truth, HR truth, or causal truth
centralizing data without policy, tenancy, portability, and deletion boundaries
ambient mailbox, calendar, financial, personal, or workplace authority
silent joins between personal and work identities or contexts
raw-copy handoff bundles when minimum-necessary governed projections will do
using automation to erase accountability or affected-party rights
making simple tasks complex to expose platform breadth
claiming universal coverage from a small set of showcase scenarios
treating a forecast or recommendation as an observed fact
requiring code for the promised primary journeys
optimizing revenue, margin, engagement, delivery speed, or infrastructure cost by externalizing privacy, safety, accessibility, support, recourse, lock-in, labor, community, or environmental harm
hidden_assumptions_to_test: coverage rosters are current and authorized
related communications can be identified accurately and explainably
all duties are delegable, reversible, and safe to transfer
actor, beneficiary, payer, and resource owner are the same principal
external providers support idempotent delegated actions and compensation
source data and contract versions are complete and current
each delay or anomaly has one identifiable cause
one visual grammar works equally well for every role
simplicity and unlimited configurability can coexist without progressive disclosure
public comparator documentation reveals the comparator's limits
consent, employment, consumer, financial, and legal obligations are uniform across jurisdictions

economics_and_sustainability_contract.authority_continuity: Accepted ADR-0174 cost attribution, chargeback, anomaly, and evidence obligations and Accepted ADR-0199 per-tenant OpenCost and FOCUS-normalized substrate obligations remain controlling until an explicit Accepted successor reconciles them.

economics_and_sustainability_contract.decision_rule: A financially attractive option is not admissible when its benefit depends on hiding, transferring, or making another principal absorb a material safety, privacy, accessibility, support, recourse, lock-in, labor, community, or environmental cost.

benchmark_and_measurement_contract.comparator_posture: Palantir Foundry, AIP, Apollo, and Gotham are one user-supplied, URL-only minimum baseline among multiple relevant enterprise, infrastructure, workflow, analytics, and consumer comparators. Comparator evidence is harvest-only and subject to legal/JCR disposition; it is not a template or a product-scope denominator.
benchmark_and_measurement_contract.legal_boundary: Do not scrape, copy, reverse engineer, or infer protected product shape. Until qualified legal/JCR disposition exists, preserve user-supplied comparator URLs without automated expansion and mark unsupported observations Unknown.

benchmark_and_measurement_contract.population_rule: No metric family counts as evidence until its protocol and denominator are populated for the frozen candidate. Aggregate improvement cannot hide a failing subgroup, transferred cost, or missing affected population.
benchmark_and_measurement_contract.claim_rule: Every better, simpler, faster, safer, more complete, real-time, no-training, or end-to-end claim must name the participant population, journey, source set, conditions, comparator, measure, threshold, evaluator, evidence freshness, and known exclusions.

roadmap_admission: Trace every roadmap outcome to one or more named user jobs and representative scenarios.
Define the role and journey denominator before claiming broad coverage.
Separate semantic capability from UI view, integration mechanism, and deployment mechanism.
Define success, failure, exception, recourse, security, privacy, accessibility, localization, and operations for each material journey.

Prove cross-domain continuity for identity, policy, data, lineage, observability, and recourse, and map every responsibility separately through the current execution-profile vocabulary, Accepted ADR-0280 substrate topology, and Accepted ADR-0562/0615 capability ownership faces.

Map admitted outcomes into the current Accepted capability-first hyperscale monorepo authority, including bounded ownership, dependency direction, generated-face policy, migration compatibility, rollout order, and rollback; this requirement does not itself authorize a reorganization wave.

Treat communications, mail, messaging, notifications, and collaboration as composable governed capabilities and interaction modes rather than preserving channel-shaped end-user product silos by default, while preserving Accepted ADR-0615's multi-channel comms substrate unless a later Accepted successor changes it.

Parallelize migration research, inventory, dependency analysis, regression preparation, and reversible shadow moves only where ownership and files are disjoint; under Accepted ADR-0562, apply and admit one capability move per protected PR at a time, and serialize shared authority, generated projections, dependency order, and promotion.
Include migration, portability, correction, deletion, rollback, and exit behavior.
Reject orphan features that do not improve a measured outcome or satisfy a binding obligation.
Keep implementation dispatch false until the resulting roadmap is independently reviewed and separately approved.
future_specification_requirements.product_goal_exit: This intent becomes roadmap-ready only after all Stage-1 atomic controls independently pass, the product and architecture authorities ratify an immutable successor, the scenario and participant denominator is explicit, comparator use has a fresh scope-specific qualified legal/JCR disposition, and a context-free reviewer can reproduce the reasoning and evidence without relying on this conversation.

durability.archive_policy: Superseded goal prompts and contradictory planning directions must be removed from the active tree and preserved only in Git history. A readable archive directory is not an acceptable authority boundary.
durability.known_retirement_debt: Contradictory prior goal sources must have surviving invariants migrated and must then be deleted from the active tree. Their locations and contents must not be copied into this current goal; Git history is the only provenance store.
durability.update_rule: Material changes require a version bump, direct user or qualified product-authority provenance, explicit changed-outcome accounting, independent review, and protected admission. No update may silently relax HOLD(Planning), dispatch, safety, evidence, or recourse boundaries.
